title: 第5章 试炼之门第6章 装逼初显
lines: “别进来，晖儿。”
洛沉的嘴唇动完，蓝火从他脚下裂缝翻起，卷过旧工匠外套下摆。
洛晖的脚已经踏进门内。
显曜站在门外，权杖横在胸前，挡住后方试炼新生。
“洛晖，试炼会读取执念。幻象不是真人，伤却会落进星纹回路。停在入口三息，先稳住徽章。”
洛晖没有回头，右手按住胸口铜星坠。皮甲下方烫出一圈红痕，掌心蓝纹一跳一跳，跟远处洛沉手臂残痕对上节奏。
“它拿我爹吓我，就得准备挨我一刀。”
伊萨克在门外冷笑：“首层刚开就追幻象，废墟镇果然没教过试炼规矩。”
洛晖侧过半张脸：“你家规矩教得多，刚才泡沫澡也洗得标准。”
贝莎把教材抱紧，嘴角压了两次，没压住。
显曜抬杖点向门心。
“首层单人入场。其余人等候。”
黑铁门轰然合拢。
外界光线被切断。
洛晖站在蓝火矿坑中央，靴底踩到一截弯曲铁轨。铁轨上有烧黑编号，支架倾斜，废弃矿车卡在塌方石堆里。断裂蒸汽管从石壁伸出，管口吐着冷蓝火。地面裂缝纵横，火线贴着轨道流向深处。
这地方，连最角落那只破矿灯的位置都对。
十年前蓝火夜，七号井。
洛晖蹲下，指尖摸过铁轨侧面。灰烬黏在指腹，灰烬下方露出学院古星纹边角。
“拿记忆铺地板，学院经费花得挺阴间。”
前方，洛沉背影再次出现。他沿裂缝向前走，手臂星纹残痕滴下蓝火。每滴蓝火落地，铁轨旁就多一道黑色灰纹。灰纹五角向内勾，跟候考区黑星划痕同源。
洛晖追上去。
一步。
脚下矿轨多出一道黑纹。
两步。
石壁上闪过黑袍祭司袖口。
三步。
远处铁卫封锁灯亮起，钢闸落下，旧矿坑编号k-307-7在灯牌上划过。
洛晖猛地伸手，抓向洛沉肩膀。
指尖穿过幻象。
蓝火炸开，碎片画面贴着石壁飞转。洛沉把年幼孩童推向矿坑出口，自己转身，挡在黑袍祭司前方。铁卫灯阵封住井道，钢闸咔嗒落锁。蓝火从裂缝喷上来，把一切吞没。
洛晖掌心蓝火暴涨，初级徽章急促闪烁，银面边缘裂出细红警纹。
门外观测室。
星纹观测镜悬在桌前，镜面里正映着旧矿坑幻象。两名执纪生拿着记录板，几名试炼记录员站在后排。伊萨克也被允许旁观，身后贵族新生低声议论。
“首层还没见守门兽，他先失控。”
“贫民觉醒者就这样，力量粗，回路乱。”
显曜没有接话。手指按在胸前破损徽章上，徽章边缘被长袍遮住，只露出烧黑裂痕。他另一只手抬起，把洛晖原初反应记录单独锁入铅灰晶片。
门内，洛晖咬住布条，硬把蓝火压回腕骨。
content_en:
"Don't come in, Hui'er."
After Luo Chen's lips moved, the blue fire rolled up from the crack under his feet and rolled through the hem of the old craftsman's coat.
Luo Hui's foot has already stepped into the door.
Xian Yao stood outside the door with his scepter across his chest, blocking the rear from testing the new students.
"Luo Hui, the trial will read the obsession. The illusion is not a real person, but the injury will fall into the star pattern circuit. Stop at the entrance for three breaths and stabilize the badge first."
Luo Hui didn't look back and held the bronze star pendant on his chest with his right hand. There was a circle of red marks on the bottom of the leather armor, and the blue lines on the palms of his hands jumped, matching the rhythm of the remaining marks on Luo Chen's arms in the distance.
"If it scares me from my father, it has to be prepared to be stabbed by me."
Isaac sneered outside the door: "I chased the illusion as soon as the first floor opened. It turns out that Ruin Town has not taught any trial rules."
Luo Hui turned half of his face: "Your family has a lot of rules, and the bubble bath just now was standard."
Bertha hugged the textbook tightly and pressed the corner of her mouth twice, but failed to hold it down.
Xian Yao raised his staff and pointed at the door.
"Single person enters on the first floor. The rest will wait."
The black iron door slammed shut.
Outside light is cut off.
Luo Hui stood in the middle of the Blue Fire Mine, and the soles of his boots stepped on a curved rail. There are burnt black numbers on the rails, the supports are tilted, and abandoned mine carts are stuck in the collapsed rocks. A broken steam pipe protruded from the stone wall, its mouth spitting out cold blue fire. There are cracks in the ground, and lines of fire flow deep along the tracks.
In this place, even the broken miner's lamp in the far corner is in the right position.
Ten years ago, Blue Fire Night, Well No. 7.
Luo Hui squatted down and touched the side of the rail with his fingertips. The ashes stuck to the fingertips, and the edges of the ancient star pattern of the academy were exposed underneath the ashes.
"Paving the floor with memories will cost the college money like hell."
Ahead, Luo Chen's back appeared again. He walked forward along the crack, blue fire dripping from the star marks on his arms. Every time a drop of blue fire falls to the ground, there will be a black and gray streak next to the railway track. The five corners of the gray pattern hook inward, which is the same as the black star scratches in the examination candidate area.
Luo Hui chased after him.
step.
There is a black streak on the mine track under your feet.
Two steps.
The cuffs of the black-robed priest flashed on the stone wall.
Three steps.
In the distance, the iron guard's blockade light came on, the steel gate fell, and the old mine number K-307-7 was crossed out on the light sign.
Luo Hui suddenly stretched out his hand and grabbed Luo Chen's shoulder.
Fingertips running through the illusion.
The blue fire exploded, and the fragmented screen flew against the stone wall. Luo Chen pushed the young child towards the exit of the mine, turned around, and stood in front of the black-robed priest. The iron guard lamp array sealed the shaft, and the steel gate clicked into place. Blue fire shot up from the cracks and engulfed everything.
The blue fire in Luo Hui's palm surged, the junior badge flashed rapidly, and thin red warning lines cracked on the edge of the silver surface.
Observation room outside the door.
The star pattern observation mirror hangs in front of the table, and the illusion of the old mine is reflected in the mirror. Two discipline students held record boards, and several trial recordkeepers stood in the back row. Isaac was also allowed to watch, and the new nobles behind him whispered.
"We haven't seen the gatekeeper on the first floor yet, so he lost control first."
"That's what poor people are awakened to. They have strong power and chaotic circuits."
Xian Yao didn't answer. He pressed his fingers on the broken badge on his chest. The edge of the badge was covered by his robe, only the blackened cracks were exposed. He raised his other hand and locked Luo Hui's original reaction record individually into the lead-gray chip.
Inside the door, Luo Hui bit the cloth strip and pressed the blue fire back to his wrist bone.
